messages:
ryan: Noticing recurring "window-offset" drift — customer metrics undercounted ~1.5% for two windows. Opening follow-up.
leah: Do we have spans missing or double-count?
ryan: Missing spans. Root cause looks like compaction job (log-compact) ran while ETL consumer was checkpointing, causing the in-flight buffer files to be pruned.
maia: Reproducer: compaction + small-window checkpoint race. Patch idea: mark checkpoints as immutable until compaction ack.
sre-oncall: We had silence on the drift alert because it was grouped under generic delta alerts. I'll separate drift into a dedicated page rule.
data-eng-bot: scheduled: compaction-job/rotation triggered at 2024-02-12T03:10Z (job id: comp-3344)
ryan: Proposed actions: 1) Leah -> patch compactor to wait for checkpoint ack (PR by Tue EOD); 2) Maia -> backfill replay script + verification (run tonight); 3) SRE -> split drift alert + add page for >0.5% sustained 15m; 4) Infra -> add compaction-defer flag during high-ingest windows.
leah: PR opened: https://git.redwood/internal/pull/4902. Tests included. ETA: code review 24h.
maia: Backfill script (dry-run): `python scripts/replay_windows.py --from 2024-02-11T22:00Z --to 2024-02-12T04:00Z --partitions 0-15 --dry-run` -> estimated 85k spans. Starting real run now.
infra-bot: deploybot: Deployment compactor/hold-checkpoint to canary started (job id: deploy-8440)
sre-oncall: New drift alert live: `etl_window_drift`: (kafka_ingested - etl_inserted) / kafka_ingested > 0.005 for 15m -> page.
maia: Backfill completed: 84,732 spans reprocessed. Drift reduced 1.48% -> 0.07%. Posting checksum and billing delta to #observability-results.
ryan: Good. Next steps: Leah to merge and schedule compactor rollout after 6h of clean metrics; Maia to add nightly regression that simulates compaction during checkpoint; SRE to monitor drift for 72h. I'll file JIRA and update postmortem.
sre-oncall: I'll add an autosnooze exemption so maintenance windows cannot suppress drift pages.
ryan: Thanks all — check-in on owners at Friday sync.
